subject.title: #95939 regression: bootstrapMaxChars/bootstrapTotalMaxChars deleted on every restart

question: Should `agents.defaults.bootstrapMaxChars` and `agents.defaults.bootstrapTotalMaxChars` be allowed through the agent-facing Gateway `config.apply`/`config.patch` trust boundary as a narrow persistence repair?
rationale: Source inspection shows the protected-path guard gap, but deciding that untrusted agents may persistently tune bootstrap resource limits is a security-boundary choice rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Require live proof, then allow exact paths
options.body: Ask for a current-main failing proof or live restart/write proof, then accept only these schema-backed bootstrap limit paths if the security tradeoff is approved.

options.title: Keep paths protected for now
options.body: Leave the model-facing allowlist unchanged and ask the reporter for logs or a live reproduction that proves deletion outside the agent tool path.

options.title: Fix persistence outside the agent tool
options.body: If restart deletion reproduces without agent-facing config writes, repair the startup/doctor/config-write path without expanding `ALLOWED_GATEWAY_CONFIG_PATHS`.

recommendation.title: Require live proof, then allow exact paths
recommendation.body: Ask for a current-main failing proof or live restart/write proof, then accept only these schema-backed bootstrap limit paths if the security tradeoff is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history owner for the current Gateway config mutation guard boundary.
